notes.subject: האספסף
notes.rationale: Tok bilong ol manmeri i no save olgeta — em i wanpela ples tasol long Tanakh we dispela tok i stap

notes.subject: יאכלנו
notes.rationale: Hibru i tok 'husat bai i kaikaiim yumi' o 'husat bai i givim kaikai long yumi' — ol tanim tok i tok 'givim mit long yumi'

notes.subject: התאוו תאוה
notes.rationale: Verb na nem i wankain rorot: ol i laikim long pasin bilong 'laikim' — tok i girap girap, Tok Pisin i no save holim

translation: Na ol manmeri i kamap wantaim ol i no save olgeta long ol, ol i laikim samting nogut tru, na ol i kirap go bek, na ol pren bilong Yisrael tu i singaut, na ol i tok: Husat bai i givim ⟨את⟩ mit bilong kaikai long yumi?
